definitions.gloss: to wake with a stiff neck; to sleep in an awkward position
definitions.explanation: to sleep in an uncomfortable position that causes neck pain or stiffness upon waking

examples.japanese: ⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{寝違|ねちが}えた。
examples.english: I woke up with a stiff neck.

examples.japanese: {寝違|ねちが}えて⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{回|まわ}らない→回る：01150_mawaru⟧。
examples.english: I can't turn my neck because I slept wrong.

examples.japanese: ⟦{枕|まくら}→枕：03898_makura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}わなくて→合う：10466_au⟧{寝違|ねちが}えてしまった。
examples.english: The pillow didn't suit me and I woke with a stiff neck.

notes:
{寝違|ねちが}える means to sleep in an awkward position and wake up with neck or shoulder pain. A very common everyday ailment.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive), but often used with ⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ as the affected body part
- Pattern: ⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{寝違|ねちが}える

ASPECT (ている):
{寝違|ねちが}えて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ describes the ongoing state of having a stiff neck from sleeping wrong.

FORMS:
- ⟦{寝違|ねちが}え→寝違え：08034_nechigae⟧: stiff neck from sleeping (e.g., ⟦{寝違|ねちが}え→寝違え：08034_nechigae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{寝違|ねちが}えた: I woke with a stiff neck
- {寝違|ねちが}えて⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{回|まわ}らない→回る：01150_mawaru⟧: my neck won't turn because I slept wrong
- ⟦{枕|まくら}→枕：03898_makura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}わなくて→合う：10466_au⟧{寝違|ねちが}えた: the pillow didn't suit me and I got a stiff neck

COMMON CAUSES:
Often happens with an unfamiliar ⟦{枕|まくら}→枕：03898_makura⟧ (pillow), sleeping in an unusual position, or on a ⟦{硬|かた}い→硬い：01116_katai⟧ surface.
